python3 << 'EOF'
import statistics

# Individual income tax receipts FY1929-1942 (in thousands of dollars)
# From the 1942 bulletin, page 76, column "Individual"
receipts_thousands = {
    1929: 1095541,
    1930: 1146845,
    1931: 833648,
    1932: 427191,
    1933: 352573,
    1934: 419509,
    1935: 527113,
    1936: 674416,
    1937: 1091741,
    1938: 1286312,
    1939: 1028834,
    1940: 982017,
    1941: 1417655,
    1942: 3262800,
}

# Convert to billions (thousands / 1,000,000)
receipts_billions = {year: val/1000000 for year, val in receipts_thousands.items()}

years = list(receipts_billions.keys())
values = list(receipts_billions.values())

print("Years:", years)
print("Receipts (billions):", values)

# Calculate OLS regression
# slope = sum((x-xbar)*(y-ybar)) / sum((x-xbar)**2)
# intercept = ybar - slope*xbar

xbar = statistics.mean(years)
ybar = statistics.mean(values)

numerator = sum((x - xbar) * (y - ybar) for x, y in zip(years, values))
denominator = sum((x - xbar)**2 for x in years)

slope = numerator / denominator
intercept = ybar - slope * xbar

print(f"\nOLS Regression:")
print(f"Slope: {slope}")
print(f"Intercept: {intercept}")

# Project to FY2000
year_2000 = 2000
projected_2000 = slope * year_2000 + intercept
print(f"\nProjected FY2000: {projected_2000} billions")

# Actual FY2000 from 2001 bulletin
# In millions, convert to billions
actual_2000_millions = 1004461  # From "Net (4)" column for 2000
actual_2000 = actual_2000_millions / 1000000
print(f"Actual FY2000: {actual_2000} billions")

# Difference (actual - projected)
diff = actual_2000 - projected_2000
print(f"\nDifference (actual - projected): {diff}")

# Round to nearest tenths
diff_rounded = round(diff, 1)
print(f"Rounded to nearest tenths: {diff_rounded}")
EOF

import statistics

# Individual income tax receipts FY1929-1942 (in thousands of dollars)
# From the 1942 bulletin, page 76, column "Individual"
receipts_thousands = {
    1929: 1095541,
    1930: 1146845,
    1931: 833648,
    1932: 427191,
    1933: 352573,
    1934: 419509,
    1935: 527113,
    1936: 674416,
    1937: 1091741,
    1938: 1286312,
    1939: 1028834,
    1940: 982017,
    1941: 1417655,
    1942: 3262800,
}

# Convert to billions (thousands / 1,000,000)
receipts_billions = {year: val/1000000 for year, val in receipts_thousands.items()}

years = list(receipts_billions.keys())
values = list(receipts_billions.values())

print("Data for OLS regression (FY1929-1942):")
for y, v in receipts_billions.items():
    print(f"  FY{y}: {v:.6f} billions")

# Calculate OLS regression
xbar = statistics.mean(years)
ybar = statistics.mean(values)

numerator = sum((x - xbar) * (y - ybar) for x, y in zip(years, values))
denominator = sum((x - xbar)**2 for x in years)

slope = numerator / denominator
intercept = ybar - slope * xbar

print(f"\nOLS Regression Results:")
print(f"  Slope: {slope:.8f}")
print(f"  Intercept: {intercept:.8f}")

# Project to FY2000
year_2000 = 2000
projected_2000 = slope * year_2000 + intercept

# Actual FY2000 from 2001 bulletin
# Column "Net (4)" under "Income taxes" = individual income tax net of refunds
# Value = 1,004,461 million dollars = 1,004.461 billion dollars
actual_2000_millions = 1004461
actual_2000 = actual_2000_millions / 1000  # Convert million to billion

print(f"\nProjected FY2000 (from regression): {projected_2000:.6f} billions")
print(f"Actual FY2000 (reported): {actual_2000:.3f} billions")

# Difference (actual - projected)
diff = actual_2000 - projected_2000
print(f"\nDifference (actual - projected): {diff:.6f} billions")

# Round to nearest tenths
diff_rounded = round(diff, 1)
print(f"Rounded to nearest tenths: {diff_rounded}")
EOF
